description_en: Deletes a single user group from a bastion host
description_zh: 删除单个堡垒机用户组
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost delete-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id '１' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host from which you want to delete the user group.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除用户组的堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host from which you want to delete the user group.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除用户组的堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group that you want to delete.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除的用户组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_group_id

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
